mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM analysis_cache_record c JOIN ai_analysis a ON a.id=c.analysis_id WHERE c.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND c.cache_source_id IS NULL AND a.event_id=#{eventId} AND a.status='SUCCESS' AND a.created_at >= #{cutoff} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT saved_tokens FROM analysis_cache_record WHERE analysis_id=#{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_model_attempt (event_id, model, outcome, elapsed_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{model}, #{outcome}, #{elapsed}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cache_source_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) cache_hits, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cache_source_id IS NOT NULL THEN saved_tokens ELSE 0 END),0) saved_tokens FROM analysis_cache_record

SELECT COUNT(*) call_count, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens),0) prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens),0) completion_tokens, AVG(elapsed_ms) avg_ms, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prompt_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) unknown_tokens FROM analysis_model_attempt
SELECT id,event_id,model,outcome,elapsed_ms,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,created_at FROM analysis_model_attempt ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
